title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Images 9–15, dark-theme amber peak bands; insulin.jsx Curve()
findings.title: Peak overlays defeat the stated 4.5:1 contrast target
findings.problem: The dark-theme accent trace crossing the 55%-opacity amber bands has approximately 3.0–3.2:1 contrast against the composited background, not the claimed 4.5:1. This misses the project's explicit target, although non-text graphics ordinarily have a 3:1 WCAG threshold.
findings.fix: Reduce the amber fill opacity or separate the trace from the band with a card-colored halo. Test the composited colors, including the underlying teal area fill, rather than checking palette tokens alone.

assessment: One confirmed contrast-rule failure. No incorrect clock-window branch was found for the supported insulin types, including midnight rollover and peakless glargine.
